name: Уведомления и оповещения
scope: Private inbox, badge, all/unread/archive, detail and destinations
Critical inbox popup and local event reminders

Owner campaign editor, language versions, audience, search, review, cancellation and statistics

fixes.problem: Refresh shortened an already loaded history range; retry of an older page restarted at the beginning.
fixes.result: Retain the confirmed range, resume the failed cursor, and coalesce the same refresh without discarding readable records.

fixes.problem: A cached row could still offer actions after its server record disappeared.
fixes.result: A single targeted authoritative read gates actions, with readable cached content during verification, separate network retry, and an unavailable state for deleted/inaccessible records. Mutation errors belong to the exact detail.

fixes.problem: A copied data.id could disagree with the authoritative Firestore document path.
fixes.result: Use the document ID and parent inbox account; verified with deliberately wrong copied identifiers through the actual SDK.

fixes.problem: Lost save response could advance revisions again or leave a successful operation reported as failed. Cancellation did not check the reviewed revision.
fixes.result: Stable operation identity plus normalized fingerprint, authoritative get/readback, exact reviewed content and cancellation revision; legacy clients remain supported.

fixes.problem: In-flight commands/receipts and deferred feedback could continue after a session change.
fixes.result: Principal binding on client and server, view/task invalidation, session fences before follow-up actions and reset of pending feedback.

fixes.problem: An older history response could undo a newer cancellation from the active feed.
fixes.result: Check the active snapshot revision, reread the affected page once, preserve history on failed-page retry, and await the same active refresh before routing.

fixes.problem: Ordinary delivery set the same forced-open intent as an explicit tap.
fixes.result: Delivery refreshes the feed and respects once/acknowledge policy; only an explicit tap queues an account-bound open intent. Refresh after access becomes ready.

fixes.problem: A late receipt from a previous session could close a new popup after returning to the same account.
fixes.result: Generation fences, exact recipient eligibility, in-flight duplicate protection and visible busy state.

fixes.problem: The local reminder had no route to its event; an obsolete lead time could leave a previous pending reminder behind.
fixes.result: Exact event/account route with no invented inbox receipt; reschedule replaces the same request, an invalid/passed lead time removes it, and cancellation/session cleanup is serialized.

fixes.problem: Recipient search differed from common controls; unresolved technical IDs appeared in recipient lists; some review/statistics values used weak default secondary styling.
fixes.result: Shared search field, readable recipient fallback, theme-aware labels and vertical value layout at accessibility sizes; explicit notification-specific unavailable copy.

fixes.problem: At maximum Dynamic Type, system popovers omitted Cancel and native alerts clipped the warning even when their actions were hittable.
fixes.result: Shared large scrollable confirmation with full warning, explicit cancel/close and reachable actions for clear-all, cancel, unsaved changes and saved-version reload. Final clear and complete owner journey passed; full top/bottom frames at maximum text were viewed.

fixes.problem: Owner could see campaign feedback controls even though the shared profile policy correctly rejects self-addressed support.
fixes.result: The shared access policy governs popup/history buttons and final route; owner has no self-feedback action while admin/member retain it. Dedicated three-role UI test passed and all three frames were viewed.

baselineEvidence.meaning: Loaded range lost on refresh and duplicate same-context refresh read.
Stale history response replaced a newer cancellation.
Save replay, missing targeted owner read and stale cancel were reproduced before the server repair.

automatedVerification.note: Full unit suite passed; 39 opt-in SDK/device/OS checks are separately accounted for.

461-record private inbox, stable cursors, exact canonical identifiers, receipts/archive/delete and bulk cutoff; legacy/new callable command replay/revision; preference persistence and foreign write denial through real SDK.
Provisional authorization, exact route, lead-time replacement, stale lead-time removal, cancellation and account-transition cleanup. This is not physical APNs.
No real people, FCM or APNs were messaged; provider delivery is controlled in these tests.
Final product source including role policy and scrollable confirmations compiled for generic iOS Release without signing. Two existing concurrency warnings remain separately recorded.

performance.detailRead: One exact server document, no full inbox download.
performance.aggregation: Whole-inbox unread server count remains independent of the loaded page.
performance.archiveScope: Archive uses the bounded chronological history with an explicit older-history action; it does not claim the loaded window is the complete archive.
performance.loadEvidence: 461-record real SDK traversal and two bulk pages plus indexed recipient continuation; not a production load/latency benchmark.

production.beforeSource: Exact deployed service.ts matched ace22c40 parent before deployment.
production.afterSource: Source and compiled service.js matched all four deployed archives; Ready plus 100% traffic to each intended revision.
production.appCheck: Unauthenticated cold callable probes returned 401; this proves rejection only, not an authenticated production journey.
production.eventarc: The four changed endpoints are callables, not Eventarc triggers.

userAcceptance.requires: A subsequent signed build containing block13 and two controlled accounts/devices for real push delivery.
checklist: Own inbox: open from bell/profile, full message, read status and badge, destination then back, unread/archive/restore/delete/clear and reopen.
Owner announcement: both languages, selected people/region, preview, recipient count and exact final review, schedule/cancel and per-campaign results.
Recipient on the other device: real push with app foreground/background/closed, tap opens the intended active message, once/acknowledge and history behave consistently.
Change accounts and verify no previous account inbox, badge, receipt or delayed feedback window appears.
Disable notification permission in iOS and return; check explanation/settings route. Re-enable, test an event reminder and its exact event destination.
Check light/dark themes and the largest text size, including all confirmations and long message bodies.

knownBoundaries: Actual APNs transport and the final signed iPhone binary remain user acceptance; emulator/provider tests do not prove Apple delivery.
Android server-envelope compatibility is covered by server tests; no Android binary was built or delivered in this iOS block.
Two pre-existing Release concurrency warnings remain outside this block: SystemLogDeliveryQueue.swift:52 and DirectoryEditorAccessStore.swift:50.
